description: The bar chart, titled "Recall@10," displays the performance of four different methods—labeled "Ours," "- critiquing," "- scoring," and "- ranking"—in terms of their Recall@10 score, which is a measure of how well the top 10 recommendations include relevant items. The vertical axis represents the Recall@10 score, ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, with a scale that is linear. The horizontal axis lists the four methods being compared. The bar for "Ours" is the tallest, indicating the highest performance, with a score of approximately 0.35. The bar for "- critiquing" is the second tallest, with a score of approximately 0.3. The bar for "- ranking" has a score of approximately 0.24, and the bar for "- scoring" is the shortest, with a score of approximately 0.17. The bars are color-coded: "Ours" is shown in orange, while the other three methods are shown in blue. The chart visually demonstrates that the proposed method ("Ours") achieves a significantly higher Recall@10 score compared to the other three methods.
